newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Jordanian soldier accused of killing seven Israeli students says he is not guilty.
- Iran's president-elect says three Gulf islands disputed with United Arab Emirates belong to Iran.
- A Syrian economic team signs agreements worth $20 million with Iraq.
- Paris Club agrees to reschedule $450 million of Jordan's debts.
- Lebanon will on Wednesday send planes to evacuate Lebanese trapped in Sierra Leone.
- Summit between Egyptian president and Israeli prime minister fails to make progress.
- Russia seeks Saudi Arabian investment in its oil industry, Russian power minister says.
- Saudi Arabia's ports generated 1.2 billion riyals in revenue in 1996.
